svg.title: Print-download screen: restore a diagnostic folded-corner cue
svg.desc: Only the file icon’s upper-right path changes to a diagonal folded corner and an internal fold stroke becomes visible. Overall icon extent, remaining fragments, stroke width/color and large gaps remain fixed. Explicit filename, PDF label, A3 size, 2.4 MB value, Download PDF control, all text, photo/crop, phone and lighting are identical. Original fictional static download mockup; icon recognition has not been tested with users.
